# The clock period each design of the timing corpus achieves under Vivado
# 2026.1's timer at xc7a100tftg256-3: each clock's period less the worst setup
# slack from it to itself, in ns. tools/vivado-parity/achieved.sh and
# `achieved.py table --fixture`; docs/fpga-vivado-parity.md, "Placement and
# routing against Vivado's own flow". Run on 2026-11-06.
#   vivado <design> <clock> <ns>    Vivado's own flow, synthesis to routes, the
#                                   best of three runs at tightening periods
#   netlist <design> <clock> <ns>   Vivado's placement and routes of the
#                                   `before` build's netlist, seed 1
#   reticle <build> <seed> <design> <clock> <ns>
#                                   Reticle's placement and routes, timed by
#                                   Vivado: `before` is 04b70219, `after` with
#                                   the section's changes, both `--delay-model vivado`;
#                                   `synthesis` is `after` with the default `--synthesis
#                                   vivado` (docs/fpga-vivado-parity.md, "Synthesis
#                                   against Vivado's"), `after` being what `--synthesis
#                                   legacy` builds
#                                   `area` is `synthesis` with "Area against
#                                   Vivado's" (2026-11-07); `packing` is `area` with
#                                   "Packing against Vivado's" (2026-11-07);
#                                   `bypass` is `packing` again at seeds 6 to 10,
#                                   and `throughs` the same tree with "Eight
#                                   flip-flops a slice" (2026-11-07) at seeds 1 to
#                                   10, both on 73334987; `tree` is 38f812a0 at
#                                   seeds 1 to 10, `fill` it with the four changes
#                                   of "Filling slices" (2026-11-07) and `fillall`
#                                   those with `--route-throughs all`, each at seeds
#                                   1 to 10; `routed` is `fillall` with "Routing
#                                   against Vivado's routes" (2026-11-07), the default
#                                   now, at seeds 1 to 10, and `vroutes` `fillall`'s
#                                   placements at seeds 1 to 5 routed by Vivado,
#                                   the lookup tables' pins free (`placement_free`);
#                                   `refined` is `routed` with "A table's inputs
#                                   as Vivado gives them" (2026-11-09), the
#                                   default now, at seeds 1 to 10, on aa1420e5,
#                                   whose own build was `routed` seed for seed;
#                                   `closing` is `refined` with "The netlist
#                                   against Vivado's, placed by Vivado"
#                                   (2026-11-09), the default now, at seeds 1 to
#                                   10, on 91802be8, whose own build was
#                                   `refined` seed for seed; `fused` is
#                                   `closing` with "Three terms on one chain"
#                                   (2026-11-09), the default now, at seeds 1
#                                   to 10, on 48242e62, whose own build was
#                                   `closing` seed for seed; `copied` is `fused`
#                                   with "A wide fanout copied" (2026-11-09),
#                                   the default now, at seeds 1 to 10
#                                   `unpaired` is `copied` with "The ADC
#                                   clocks, placed" (2026-11-10), the default
#                                   now, at seeds 1 to 10, on 64b6cd2f, whose
#                                   own build was `copied` (seed 1 checked);
#                                   `tied` is `unpaired` with "A ground on the
#                                   bypass input" (2026-11-10), the default
#                                   now, at seeds 1 to 10, on a5081379, whose
#                                   own build was `unpaired` seed for seed
#                                   `through` is `tied` with "A way through to
#                                   the propagate" (2026-11-10), the default
#                                   now, at seeds 1 to 10, on a5a2811f, whose
#                                   own build was `tied` seed for seed
#   slices <build> <seed> <design> <n>
#                                   the slices that build's placement uses, every
#                                   site of its --vivado-placement export
#   vnetlist <design> <clock> <ns>  Vivado's synthesis of the design placed and
#                                   routed by Vivado, place_design and
#                                   route_design alone, every clock at 0.80 of
#                                   `vivado`'s figure and the clocks apart
#                                   (achieved.sh's `cons3`)
#   pnr <build> <seed> <design> <clock> <ns>
#                                   that build's netlist of that seed placed and
#                                   routed the same way: beside `vnetlist`, only
#                                   the netlist differs (2026-11-09); `untied` is
#                                   a5081379's, whose own build is `unpaired`, at
#                                   seeds 1 to 10 (its seeds 1 to 5 are
#                                   `unpaired`'s but for `gray_cdc` seed 1, 1.918
#                                   and 1.414 ns against 1.438 and 1.314, not
#                                   looked into)
#                                   `retied` is a5a2811f's netlist, whose own
#                                   build is `tied`, placed again (2026-11-10):
#                                   some seeds differ from `tied`'s, not
#                                   looked into; `through` that with "A way
#                                   through to the propagate", seeds 1 to 10
